workshoptitle: Product Recall Assistant: Identify Exposure Fast

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Review the recall scenario, architecture, identities, and lab flow.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Decide Whether to Open the Case: Shape the Recall Evidence with JSON
tutorials.description: Help Maya open the B-482 case and prove the recall scope from its evidence.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Put Help Where It Is Needed: Map Recall Impact with Oracle Spatial
tutorials.description: Help Elena assign every affected store to nearby response coverage.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Find the Source and the Reach: Trace Recall Paths with SQL Property Graph
tutorials.description: Help Jordan connect suspect component lots to suppliers, stores, and customers.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Hear the Signal in the Noise: Prioritize Complaint Evidence with AI Vector Search
tutorials.description: Help Priya find the complaints that support the B-482 thermal pattern.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Answer with Evidence: Build the Recall Assistant
tutorials.description: Help Marcus give investigators grounded answers from approved database tools.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Put Trusted Facts in Reach: Publish the Recall API with ORDS
tutorials.description: Help Sofia share read-only recall facts and locations without exposing the schema.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Show Each Role Only What It Needs: Make the Recall Agent Role-Aware with Deep Data Security
tutorials.description: Help Daniel prove that each role receives only its authorized B-482 evidence.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Turn Evidence into Coordinated Action: Deploy the Role-Aware React Recall Command Center
tutorials.description: Help Aisha coordinate maps, graph paths, complaints, and agent answers in one role-aware command center.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Template to link to Need Help lab at the end of workshop.
